description: This file is a plugin for the Trumbowyg rich text editor that adds color picking functionality, including language support, color conversion, and UI components for selecting text and background colors.

methods.name: hex
methods.description: Converts a numeric value to a two-digit hexadecimal string.

methods.name: colorToHex
methods.description: Converts an RGB or RGBA color string to a hexadecimal color code or 'transparent'.

methods.name: colorTagHandler
methods.description: Generates color tags based on element styles for applying color formatting.

methods.name: buildDropdown
methods.description: Builds a dropdown menu of color options for the color picker plugin.
